mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-01 GX-04 (corpus gx). HOT-FLAG 2 RESOLVED -- ERRATA-20 era RESTAMP: mapped the 0.2-dawn identity (Ancestral Warrior Totem 'version history begins at 0.2.0'; the corpus 0.1 era-claim was CONTRADICTED, errata_applied=1) -> eras 0.2-dawn onward. Ancestral Warrior Totem -> totem (placed autonomous proxy; the fetched 'Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors... Maximum of 10 totems' is the totem/sentry member). ailment=sunder for the Ancestral Warrior payload (fetched 'Ancestral Warrior SUNDER Totems'; Sunder = armour-break slam -> sunder hit-proc); stun for Shockwave Totem (heavy-hit). Physical -> element-neutral (physical rule). PLACED-PROXY COUNT (up to 10 totems) -> placed_proxy_count economy note + accrual candidate to the PLACED-PROXY-COUNT family (hiero-6-totem / tq2 forge-turrets count-8 mint class per addendum E) WITHOUT number (steward-counted). ENDURANCE-CHARGE-CONSUMED-to-raise -> accumulator spend. Wooden Wall (redirect 20% player damage-taken to totems) is a proxy-tank coupling -> noted in trigger_grammar/traits. Heavy proxy (totems do ALL damage) -> PROXY_SOVEREIGNTY (autonomous commanded proxies) + PROXY_FISSION (up-to-10 multi-totem swarm) via main-law 5 (R-M1). Warbringer ascendancy. eras 0.2-0.5 CONFIRMED (post ERRATA-20). [STEWARD AUDIT m03: 'sunder' stripped -- NAME-COLLISION + memory-supplement leak class: 'Ancestral Warrior Sunder Totems' names the poe2 SKILL Sunder as socketed payload; a skill NAME is never status attestation, and the 'Sunder is an armour-break skill' mechanics claim came from priors, not fetched text (no armour-break/exposure language in this kit's dossier). 'stun' stripped -- 'shockwave slam heavy-hit' is flavor inference; no stun named. Totem-proxy identity fully survives in geometry + PROXY doors]
